verdict.rationale: The evidence lists RustDesk's capabilities (remote view and control, file transfer, clipboard file copy) and Server Pro's per-user and device-group access control. That access control governs who can reach which devices. Nothing documents scoping a connected session to view-only, control, clipboard or file access. The generic '90+ options' claim does not name such permission toggles.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
